Koning_2018.unit: Country-year IFRS adoption status and ordinal adoption extent, 2002-2012; excludes EU/EEA collective mandates.
Koning_2018.competition: Adopter fraction among five peers selected by export-share correlation; alternative same-risk-class peers.
Koning_2018.learning: Visible success measured by GDP or per-capita growth among ten geographic peers, adopter versus nonadopter median.
Koning_2018.emulation: Cultural/administrative proximity and professional IFAC membership, not merely portfolio contact.
Koning_2018.coercion: Aid and IMF credit relative to GDP; a dependence proxy, not an observed conditionality contract.

Shipan_Volden_2008.unit: Pooled city-year-policy observations for three antismoking policies; local adoptions can occur in any order.
Shipan_Volden_2008.learning: Population share already covered by local restrictions; broad adoption exposure.
Shipan_Volden_2008.competition: Potential outflow to nearby unregulated populations relative to focal population.
Shipan_Volden_2008.imitation: Nearest larger city prior adoption; fallback for largest city differs from our missing-peer rule.
Shipan_Volden_2008.coercion: State law and preemption can reduce need/opportunity for local adoption.
Shipan_Volden_2008.extensions: Separate and joint channels, recent/older effects, size interactions.

current_adaptation.target: Public disclosure country-family first documented implementation risk; policy-phase chronology, not a fully observed first-law census.
current_adaptation.learning_extension: Separates portfolio exposure from observed same-company spread changes and observed emissions changes. Does not treat filled outcomes as observed foreign success.
current_adaptation.copying_extension: Nearest larger economy fixed by 2000 GDP and geographic ranks; recent versus older implementation. Missing peer/history remains missing.
current_adaptation.within_design: Country FE x family and Family FE x year linear probability models complement Family FE and Year FE logit; estimator/sample differences are retained, not attributed solely to one FE change.
current_adaptation.retained_liquidity: The five user-selected models remain the primary Table 3, with numerical reconstruction of all five coefficients.
current_adaptation.writing: Mechanisms motivate tests; numerical associations and institutional templates are reported as distinct evidence.
